777-3693-4659-5224.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {1} due to Foundry Inspector, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

539-1491-6218-8320.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

2317-5478-7084-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

2707-3617-5496.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Tomb Trawler by paying {2}, causing you to put Time Walk on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Walk from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

2390-3708-6191.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2390-3708-6191.description:
Gain life.
Wall of Limbs triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4871-5256-8168.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token with flying due to Draconic Visitor.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

728-1981-2415-6634.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Land that adds at least two mana

3688-4019-4221--85--172.description:
Play the land that taps for multiple mana.
That land enters as a creature due to Living Plane, triggering Vigean Graftmage's Graft ability, allowing you to move a +1/+1 counter from Vigean Graftmage to that land.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding at least two mana.
Zhur-Taa Ancient triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping the land creature.
Repeat.
3688-4019-4221--85--172.notes:
Note that either the land or the additional mana source must add blue mana.

If the land adds at least {2}{U}, the additional mana source is not necessary.

You may wait a turn after playing the land instead of using the haste enabler.

849-2438-2946-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
849-2438-2946-4871.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Anax trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5147-5542-6146.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5147-5542-6146.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Ravenloft Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Ravenloft Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Ravenloft Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Ravenloft Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Ravenloft Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Ravenloft Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Ravenloft Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Ravenloft Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5147-5542-6146.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

193-2724-3217-4450.description:
Activate Aminatou by putting 0 loyalty counter on them due to Carth the Lion, blinking Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2646-2921-4559-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
2646-2921-4559-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

628-2034-7188.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Heirloom Auntie.
When Heirloom Auntie dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

4934-5078-6289.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Amareth triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Amareth trigger, causing you to look at the top card of your library, which will be Sensei's Divining Top, and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

273-6747-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
273-6747-7070.description:
Activate Shuko's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Shuko ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Sami.
Repeat.

2034-2919-3490-3641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2919-3490-3641.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

2459-4050-4053-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that has power or toughness 1 or less and that can be cast using one colored mana.
2459-4050-4053-6989.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Rograkh.
Cast Rograkh from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the additional creature, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from your graveyard by paying its mana cost. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

465-3742-4251-4452-6965.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

4222-4474-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Pheres-Band Tromper.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

944-3054-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
944-3054-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire, adding {B}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

654-1231-5686-6644.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Gravewaker by paying {5}{B}{B}, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers ten times, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

765-1479-6529.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
765-1479-6529.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it, Curse of the Restless Dead, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Curse of the Restless Dead trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1308-4508-4875-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2730-4871-5006-5256.easyPrerequisites: Kaya's Ghostform attached to Lurrus of the Dream-Den.
2730-4871-5006-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Lurrus of the Dream-Den.
When Lurrus of the Dream-Den dies, Kaya's Ghostform and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Kaya's Ghostform trigger, returning Lurrus of the Dream-Den from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Lurrus of the Dream-Den's power.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard by paying {B}, attaching it to Lurrus of the Dream-Den.
Repeat.

549-856-1201-4853.description:
Activate Witch's Oven by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Witch's Oven.
Resolve the Witch's Oven ability, creating a Food artifact token.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food token, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1479-2374-4543.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand.
1479-2374-4543.description:
Play a land card from your hand.
Kodama, Trench Behemoth and Maja trigger.
If the land played was a basic land, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield from your hand.
Resolve the Trench Behemoth trigger, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a 1/1 Human Warrior creature token.
The Human Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Kodama.
Holding priority, activate Trench Behemoth by returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Trench Behemoth.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting a land onto the battlefield from your hand.
Trench Behemoth and Maja trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

3079-3613-4050-4999.manaNeeded: {1} if you have discarded and/or cycled exactly two cards
3079-3613-4050-4999.notablePrerequisites: You have discarded and/or cycled at least two cards this turn.
3079-3613-4050-4999.description:
Cast Hollow One from your graveyard by paying at most {1}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Hollow One, adding one mana of any color.
Hollow One is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Dress Down removing Hollow One's cycling ability.
Repeat.
If you have discarded and/or cycled three or more cards, this combo nets infinite colored mana.

659-3954-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of Goblins that is equal to or greater than six plus Krenko's commander tax.
659-3954-5231.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Goblin creature tokens equal to the number of Goblins you control.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Krenko, adding {R}.
Choose to return Krenko to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing a Goblin, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you have enough mana to cast Krenko.
Cast Krenko from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{R} plus commander tax.
Repeat.

539-1847-2608-3875.description:
Activate The Golden Throne by tapping it and sacrificing Derevi, adding {G}{W}{U}.
Choose to return Derevi to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting Derevi onto the battlefield from the command zone.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Derevi trigger, untapping The Golden Throne.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

225-2653-4967.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-2653-4967.description:
Activate Thawing Glaciers by paying {1} and tapping it, searching your library for a basic land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Nissa and Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Thawing Glaciers.
Repeat.

731-1819-3244.notablePrerequisites:
Corrupted Conscience attached to Syr Konrad.
You have at least ten creature cards between your graveyard and library.
731-1819-3244.description:
Cast Morality Shift by paying {5}{B}{B}, exchanging your library with your graveyard.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card in your graveyard and library, causing each opponent to get that many poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

868-1528-2670.notablePrerequisites: Dual Casting attached to a creature you control that does not have summoning sickness.
868-1528-2670.description:
Cast Desperate Ritual by paying {1}{R}.
As you cast Desperate Ritual, reveal Psychic Puppetry from your hand and pay {U} to add its effects to Desperate Ritual.
Holding priority, activate the creature with Dual Casting attached by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Desperate Ritual, with the copy also having the effects of Psychic Puppetry.
Resolve the Desperate Ritual copy, untapping the creature with Dual Casting attached and adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

2848-3490-4659.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three Vampires.
You control an additional creature.
2848-3490-4659.description:
Activate Indulgent Aristocrat by paying {2} and sacrificing a creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on each Vampire you control.
Animation Module triggers for each +1/+1 counter placed this way.
Resolve the first Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining Animation Module trigger.
Repeat from step 1.

1980-3014-5261.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {3}.
1980-3014-5261.description:
Activate a permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Emerald Charm without paying its mana cost, targeting Isochron Scepter.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, creating a copy of Emerald Charm, targeting the permanent that can tap to produce at least {3}.
Resolve both Emerald Charm copies, untapping Isochron Scepter and the permanent.
Repeat.

884-5035.notablePrerequisites: You have higher life total than your opponents.
884-5035.description:
Cast Plague of Vermin by paying {6}{B}.
Resolve Plague of Vermin, choosing to pay all but one life and create that many black Rat tokens.
For each Rat tokens that enters the battlefield, Ayara triggers, causing you to gain that many life and each opponent to lose that many life.
